newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FTC meeting could be on variety of subjects.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FTC meeting could be on variety of subjects.

text.p: A meeting of the five members of the Federal Trade Commission meeting at 2 p.m. EST (1900 GMT) today could be about any one of a number of subjects, a person familiar with the agenda said.
The commission has been busy in the recent past and has many items it is considering, such as new guidelines on efficiencies.
Recent controversial cases before the FTC have included a proposed merger between Staples and Office Depot .
The hastily-called meeting of the five commissioners follows by one day a final agreement between the two office superstores to divest 63 stores to the third player in the field, OfficeMax.
But there was no immediate sign the merger would come up at today's meeting.
